concerns.text: Within T008, the post-alignment power re-verification (power_verify.py, 're-triggering the power gate if N loss dropped power below 0.8') is sequenced AFTER main.py writes and final_validator.py validates results.json. If the re-check fails, a schema-valid results.json with power_status possibly stale already exists on disk. Reorder the sub-steps so power_verify runs before results.json is written/validated, or state that power_verify's output feeds the power_status field written into results.json.
